candidates.summary: resetToGenesisDoc overwrites the persisted genesis doc through saveGenesisDoc, which drops the SetSync error (node.go:1177), so a failed overwrite leaves the refused doc in place while the state record and the handshake take the corrected one
candidates.failure_scenario: Refused boot with genesis InitialHeight 1000; the operator corrects it to 100 and restarts. In the reset, SetSync(genesisDocKey) fails (I/O error) and is dropped, SaveState succeeds, the handshake applies the corrected doc held in memory and writes the height-0 key. The chain runs to height 500. On the next restart the height-0 key makes the persisted doc authoritative, and that doc is still the refused one at InitialHeight 1000. ReplayBlocks fix-a sees 500 < 999, realigns the state to 999 and saves it, then panics with StateBlockHeight (999) > StoreBlockHeight (500): the data dir no longer restarts. Before this diff saveGenesisDoc only wrote an absent key, so a dropped write was retried on the next boot; the overwrite is new. 87f41db34 made the read of the same doc fail closed, but the write still fails open.
candidates.verify_by: sed -n 1139,1147p and 1171,1178p tm2/pkg/bft/node/node.go: saveGenesisDoc returns nothing and discards db.SetSync's error; sed -n 134p tm2/pkg/bft/state/store.go: saveState does the same. Run shape: wrap memdb so SetSync(genesisDocKey) fails once, refuse InitialHeight 1000, reset to 100, SaveABCIResponses(0), set LastBlockHeight 500, call LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider again and read doc.InitialHeight: expect 100, observe 1000
candidates.evidence: node.go:1144 `saveGenesisDoc(stateDB, genDoc)`; node.go:1177 `db.SetSync(genesisDocKey, b)` with its error unchecked; store.go:134 `db.SetSync(key, state.Bytes())` likewise; dbm.DB declares `SetSync([]byte, []byte) error` (tm2/pkg/db/types.go:19)
